Definition: something conspicuous, i.e. the craw of a bird (from its prominence)
BiblicalUsage: Mur'ah is the crop of a bird, the craw — the priest takes away the crop of the burnt offering with its feathers, and casts it beside the altar on the east, by the place of the ashes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the detail is the point: even the crop is taken away, and nothing of the offering is left unhandled by the priest.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
